lead.headline: Bears Beat Buccaneers 27-24 on a Walk-Off Field Goal, Now 7-2
lead.subhead: Chicago led 14-0, watched Tampa Bay tie it at 24-24 with 2:51 left, then Caleb Williams hit Colston Loveland for 38 yards and Cairo Santos drilled a 38-yard field goal as time expired. Four straight wins. Seven is the stumble; eight is the stand.

articles.hed: Williams Answers After a Rough Night
articles.body: Caleb Williams threw four interceptions and still engineered the eight-play, 49-yard winning drive in the final minutes. Chicago held on for a 27-24 win at Soldier Field before 60,470 fans. Ugly night, perfect finish: the rebound is the whole story.

articles.hed: Sixers Start 9-2 With LeBron in the Mix
articles.body: Philadelphia beat the Bulls 127-121 behind Jaylen Brown's 29 and Tyrese Maxey's 27 for its best 11-game start since 2000-01. Meanwhile Austin Reaves poured in 43 to carry the Lakers past Detroit without Luka Doncic.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Monday, the day of the Moon. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. The Moon rules tides and instinct: set the rhythm of the week before the week sets it for you.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go own Monday.

mindset.body: The Bears were up 24-13, got tied, and still found a way in the last minute. Williams had a rough night and kept swinging. Sales works the same way: the call that goes sideways is not the last call. Make the next dial, make the next ask, finish the drive. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Monday, the day of the Moon: run this right after Morning Charge. Dawn is cold (about 36°, feels near 31°), so keep the RipStick finisher indoors. Strong, smooth reps to start the week.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: xAI turns on Grok API text watermarking by default
items.body: As of Nov 7, text from seven current Grok model variants carries an invisible statistical watermark on every xAI API endpoint, with a per-request header integrators can read. xAI cites EU AI Act compliance ahead of the Dec 2 deadline.

items.hed: Apple eyes an agentic Siri as soon as next year
items.body: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple wants Siri to act more like an agent, and CEO John Ternus told Craig Federighi to accelerate the roadmap. Apple also documented MCP access so outside agents can build in Xcode.

items.hed: OpenAI's Dots can now fill sign-in codes from a connected inbox
items.body: With permission, OpenAI's Dots agent can use sign-in codes sent to a connected inbox to log in. OpenAI staff also clarified that all Pro plans have no five-hour limits.

items.hed: Reaves drops 43 as Lakers beat Pistons without Doncic
items.body: Austin Reaves scored 43 and Walker Kessler added 12 points and 16 boards as Los Angeles won 121-116 in Detroit.

items.hed: Flagg posts career-high 12 assists as Mavs rout Nets 130-93
items.body: Cooper Flagg had 25 points and 12 assists for his third straight double-double. Giannis added 29 and 14 boards in Miami's 114-108 win at Sacramento.

items.hed: Sixers improve to 9-2 with LeBron's best Philly night
items.body: Jaylen Brown scored 29, Maxey 27 and LeBron a season-high 22 in a 127-121 win over the Bulls. Minnesota (8-3) has won four straight, and Boston beat Milwaukee 117-97.

items.hed: Bears edge Bucs 27-24 on Santos' walk-off kick
items.body: Chicago led 24-13 entering the fourth, then Tampa tied it. Williams hit Loveland for 38 yards and Santos kicked the 38-yard winner at the gun. The Bears have won four straight.

items.hed: Trade deadline is Tuesday at 4 PM ET
items.body: Chicago already added Jeffery Simmons, San Francisco added DeForest Buckner, Seattle added Quenton Nelson and Baltimore added Jacoby Brissett. A flurry could come before the cutoff.

items.hed: Week 9 takeaways: 49ers 7-1 after beating Las Vegas 38-17
items.body: San Francisco got Nick Bosa and Demarcus Robinson back from injury and holds the NFC's top seed in sight. Seattle's defense again held a foe to three points.

items.hed: UFC 334 countdown: Gane vs. Hokit at MSG
items.body: Champion Ciryl Gane makes his first heavyweight title defense against unbeaten Josh Hokit on Nov 14 in New York. The Countdown episode dropped Sunday.

items.hed: UFC 334 card is complete, with Thompson's final fight
items.body: Kayla Harrison defends against Amanda Nunes in the co-main, and Stephen Thompson meets Charles Radtke in the final fight of his career.

items.hed: Johnny Walker volunteers as UFC 334 backup
items.body: Fresh off his head-kick knockout of Waldo Cortes-Acosta, Walker says he is ready for a short-notice call at MSG and wants a title shot after one more win.

Monday belongs to Luna: intuition, tides, dreams and the cycle of return. Old magicians used it for beginnings and for seeing what is hidden. Start the week by writing one intention you will check again at night.

In the Gnostic myth, Sophia, Wisdom, falls out of the fullness and is lifted back by her own longing. It is the oldest fall-and-rise story in the book. Today, name one place you fell and the single step that brings you back.

items.hed: Hermes Trismegistus: as above, so below
items.body: The Emerald Tablet teaches that the inner and outer worlds answer each other. Fix the small pattern and the large one shifts. Make your bed of work today: one tidy, finished task sets the tone for the rest.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again' (Proverbs 24:16). The proverb itself counts the falls and still ends on the rise. A setback is not a verdict; the getting up is the character.
grimoire.practice: Today, when one call or task goes sideways, take a breath and make the next attempt within five minutes.
